name: Oumi Nozomi
source:
[b]"Good morning, sunshiine!"[/b]

Nozomi is the perfect senpai, admired by everyone at Hoshikuzu Dormitory. Beneath the polished exterior, though, lies a girl with an unshakable will and a secret she's kept close to her heart: the dorm mother (male) changed her life when they were kids.

Reunited under the same roof, her long-held gratitude transforms into something far more complicated... and she's determined to use her courage—and her curves—to finally make him notice her.
